entities.name: Mending Era
entities.description: The 62-year historical period following the Great Mending of 4500 AR, when planeswalkers were drastically weakened.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: The repair of Dominaria's time rifts in 4500 AR that weakened planeswalkers throughout the Multiverse.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane whose time rifts were repaired in the Great Mending.

entities.name: Planeswalkers
entities.description: Once near-immortal and godlike beings who became mortal or long-lived mages with limited abilities.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: Plane whose Great Aurora cycle culminated in the Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: An interplanar mercantile and espionage network that collapsed.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane whose shards were reunited in the Conflux.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane where the Eldrazi were released.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who took part in the Release of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who took part in the Release of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who took part in the Release of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who took part in the Release of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane created after the corruption of Mirrodin by the Phyrexian oil.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane that endured the Siege of Thraben, the Sundering of the Helvault and the Travails.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane of the Implicit Maze, the Living Guildpact and the War of the Spark.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The first multiversal war fought on a single plane, orchestrated by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Orchestrator of the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A newly formed group that opposed Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane of the Silence of the Gods and the fall of Xenagos.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Plane of the Aether Revolt.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Plane where Orazca was rediscovered.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Plane of the War of the Gods.

entities.name: Adversary War
entities.description: A war on Capenna in the final year of the era.

entities.name: Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: An invasion of Dominaria during which Teferi's Temporal Projection sought to recover the lost knowledge of the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Teferi's Temporal Projection
entities.description: Effort to recover the lost knowledge of the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: A full-scale multiversal war that drew in nearly every major power of the planes.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders ultimately defeated in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: The event after the Invasion that stripped most surviving planeswalkers of their sparks.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Stable channels of interplanar travel that suddenly appeared, beginning the Omenpath Era.

events.summary: The Great Mending of 4500 AR repairs Dominaria's time rifts and drastically weakens planeswalkers, beginning the Mending Era.
events.quote: the repair of Dominaria's time rifts drastically weakened planeswalkers throughout the Multiverse

events.summary: On Lorwyn-Shadowmoor the Great Aurora cycle culminates in the Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor; the Infinite Consortium collapses.
events.quote: the Infinite Consortium collapsed, ending a major interplanar mercantile and espionage network

events.summary: The Conflux reunites the shards of Alara, sparking wars between their cultures.
events.quote: The Conflux reunited the shards of Alara

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol, Chandra Nalaar, Jace Beleren and Nissa Revane release the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
events.quote: the Release of the Eldrazi by Sarkhan Vol , Chandra Nalaar , Jace Beleren , and Nissa Revane

events.summary: New Phyrexia is created after the Phyrexian oil corrupts Mirrodin.
events.quote: New Phyrexia was created after the corruption of Mirrodin by the Phyrexian oil

events.summary: Innistrad endures the Siege of Thraben, the Sundering of the Helvault, the Travails, and the Unmaking of Avacyn.
events.quote: Innistrad endured the Siege of Thraben

events.summary: The Supreme Verdict creates the Living Guildpact on Ravnica, followed by the War of the Spark, orchestrated by Nicol Bolas and opposed by the newly formed Gatewatch.
events.quote: orchestrated by Nicol Bolas and opposed by the newly formed Gatewatch

events.summary: Other worlds face upheavals: the Silence of the Gods and fall of Xenagos on Theros, the Aether Revolt on Kaladesh, Orazca on Ixalan, and the War of the Gods on Kaldheim.
events.quote: the War of the Gods on Kaldheim

events.summary: In the final year, the Adversary War on Capenna and the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria escalate tensions, leading into the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: a full-scale multiversal war that drew in nearly every major power of the planes

events.summary: The Phyrexians are defeated, but the Desparkening strips most surviving planeswalkers of their sparks.
events.quote: stripped most surviving planeswalkers of their sparks

events.summary: Stable Omenpaths suddenly appear, creating new channels of interplanar travel and beginning the Omenpath Era.
events.quote: the sudden appearance of stable Omenpaths created new channels of interplanar travel

relations.note: Gatewatch opposed Bolas in the War of the Spark
relations.quote: orchestrated by Nicol Bolas and opposed by the newly formed Gatewatch
